item.tib: dbal gsas khyung nag gi sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: zhes rgyud phyag nor bu'i phreng ba 'di zhu rnam rgyal grags pa'i (pas) khyung nag bsnyen sgrub thun mtshams skabs su sbyar ba'o/ rgyud pa'i rim pa zam ma chad pa rang 'dra rmongs pa rnams la phan phyir bris// dbal gsas rngam pa khyung gi sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ las kyi kha tshar mdel kha dang bcas pa/ yang gsang rtsod zlog klu nad gso ba/ klu bon ye shes snying po'i gdams pa/ rgyung yar khod spungs kyi man ngag hris pa gyer med kyi brnag pa/ dran pa nam mkhas phyi rabs don du/ zang zang lha brag dbu rtseRa bris shing zang zang dang rgyung srub brag dkar dang ra gsum la bcol lo/ ma bdud la sogs yum sras lnga la gtad/ phyi rabs lnga brgya'i dus na/ sa 'og klu rnams steng du thon/ mi la mdze shu gnyan nad dar/ de dus 'gro ba'i don ru (du) shog ces gsungs nas sbas pa'o//
